card.name: Inside rare names and drug names
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through uncommon proper names, drug names or foreign words, often just after a short opening fragment such as av, Ne, A or Shar. Also apostrophe-like marks inside place and Hawaiian or Arabic names.

modes.label: Drug name pieces
modes.description: Middle piece of a drug name split into parts, such as statin or neomycin names.

modes.label: Foreign or historic names
modes.description: Middle piece or apostrophe in a place name, tribe name or Latin inscription.
